medical_document_text: RADIATION ONCOLOGY - TREATMENT PLAN SUMMARY. PATIENT: John Doe. MRN: 9982314. DATE: 10/24/2023. ATTENDING PHYSICIAN: Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD, PhD. DIAGNOSIS: Malignant neoplasm of prostate (cT2b N0 M0), Gleason 7 (4+3). TREATMENT PLANNING PROCESS: The patient underwent CT simulation in the supine position with a customized immobilization device (Knee-Lok and foot support) and a comfortably full bladder. The CT dataset was imported into the Eclipse treatment planning system. CONTOURING: I personally reviewed and approved all target volumes and organs at risk (OARs). Gross Tumor Volume (GTV): Prostate gland. Clinical Target Volume (CTV): Prostate and proximal seminal vesicles. Planning Target Volume (PTV): CTV + 0.5 cm margin (0.3 cm posteriorly). OARs contoured: Bladder, rectum, penile bulb, and bilateral femoral heads. PLAN DESIGN & DOSIMETRY: A 3-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT) plan was generated. Multiple coplanar 15 MV photon beams were arranged to optimize target coverage while minimizing dose to the adjacent critical structures. DOSE PRESCRIPTION: Total Dose: 79.2 Gy. Fractionation: 1.8 Gy per fraction x 44 fractions. PLAN EVALUATION: Dose-volume histograms (DVH) were generated and critically evaluated. PTV coverage: >95% of the PTV receives 100% of the prescription dose. Rectum: V70 < 20%, V50 < 50%. Bladder: V70 < 30%, V50 < 50%. Femoral heads: Max dose < 45 Gy. All normal tissue constraints have been met. The 3D treatment plan is approved for clinical use. The patient will proceed with QA and first treatment delivery. Electronically signed by: Sarah Jenkins, MD, PhD.
